title: Splitter (stale) — what drift looks like
$comment: Deliberately out of date, and kept that way on purpose. It describes a Splitter that renamed 'Work it out' to 'Calculate split' and had a #tip field, so `nolan verify examples/drift/stale.screenplay.json` fails against the real app in examples/site. That failure is the point: it's the demo used on the landing page and in the README to show what drift looks like. Do not 'fix' these targets. It lives in a subdirectory so the examples/*.screenplay.json globs (lint:demos, the onboarding menu) skip it.

beats.text: Put in what the trip cost.
